arathi_moor_shepherd: Ogrin. I was an axethrower for the Horde. Now I keep the stag herd off the road, here on the High Moor north of Refuge Pointe, because the garrison eats what I can keep alive. The raptors have been taking stags, and lately something bigger has been taking the raptors.
arathi_refuge_commander: Commander Zel Raskal. This is Refuge Pointe, the Horde's camp in the west of the Arathi Highlands. We hold the road, the gap in Thoradin's Wall behind us, and these ruins. The Syndicate hold Stromgarde Keep, south-west of here, and they have been putting bodies on my road.
arathi_refuge_scout: Grim Hollowfoot, scout for Refuge Pointe. The moor looks empty and it is not. There are raptors on the High Moor to the north, Witherbark trolls in a hollow in the far north-east, and Syndicate in the keep to the south-west. I need someone to walk it and tell me how long it takes.
arathi_goshek_informant: Nalla Deeps. I watch Go'Shek Farm for the Commander - it is just south-east of this rise, in the east of the moor. The Syndicate took the farm two years ago, and it still brings in a harvest. Somebody is buying that grain, and I want to know who.
arathi_wall_warden: Warden Ada Rook. This is the gap in Thoradin's Wall. Hillsbrad is behind you and the Arathi Highlands are ahead. I was posted here a year and a half ago to stop whatever came through, and you are the first thing that has. Refuge Pointe is east along the road - report to Commander Raskal there.
arathi_stromgarde_antiquarian: Vesh, antiquarian. That is Stromgarde Keep behind me, in the south-west corner of the highlands. It was the capital of Arathor, the first human kingdom. The Syndicate are living in the upper ruin and have not found the stair down to the older one. I would like to reach it before they do.
